newsitem.title: USA: Veritas sees Q1 boosted by $60 mln in revs.
newsitem.headline: Veritas sees Q1 boosted by $60 mln in revs.

text.p: Veritas DGC Inc said Tuesday that it expects a positive impact on financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 1998, which began in August, reflecting agreements with several customers for additional prefunding and data sales in excess of $60 million.

Veritas said the majority of the sales involve surveys that are either ongoing or scheduled to take place over the next two years, while about 35 percent relates to completed surveys. The announced data sales significantly exceed the its expected levels for the first quarter of fiscal 1998, said Veritas.
Veritas DGC provides land, transition zone and marine- based seismic data acquisition, seismic data processing and multi-client data sales to the petroleum industry.
